stockGuards.note: V7.2 (0.2.0-experimental): the light Part apply's LFO AUTO CHANGE test, tst.b of one byte; a jsr to dj_lfoq, which replays it unless a jump has just deferred the per-track part.

V7.3 (0.2.0-experimental): stock's pattern switch calling COND_RESET(-1), a jsr after its pea -1; a jsr to dj_swres, which re-bases the jump's clock to this restart and tail-jumps COND_RESET (return address 0x400a4856 and the -1 left as stock's call made them).
The per-track scale seed of a track's manual start (0.1.1-experimental): the cave redoes all 18 bytes; only the first instruction becomes its jmp.
The [PTN]-layer YES press slot: NULL in stock, written with the unit's dj_toggle.

excluded: The author's BATCH_BUGFIXES module as such: not a prerequisite. Its MIDI_PLAYS_FREE_FIX source is carried in this module (since 0.1.1-experimental); its EMPTY_PATTERN_LED_FIX and PART_CHANGE_CARRYOVER_FIX are not.

The author's standalone builder tools/build_direct_jump_kyoti.py, his combined KYOTI image and his emulator diagnostics (tools/cmp_reflock.py, diag_reflock.py, check_dj_part.py, diag_dj_partpub.py, diag_dj_switchpop.py), which read a firmware file; the Modwerk gate (verify.py) checks the same behaviours with its own code.

notes: 0.2.0-experimental moves the pin from the octabam wrapper (sambanks/octabam b725fb1a, author pin 329b801c) to the author's repository at cd788e9: DIRECT JUMP V7.3 (prepared at 109f54c, V7.2.2; V7.3 makes the last restart, PLAY or a stock pattern change, a jump's time origin, with a fifth detour at 0x400a4850). upstream/OCTABAM_README.md and upstream/OCTABAM_LICENSE stay as imported from octabam for its integration credit.
patch_directjump_v7.s comments describe stock routines and data by address and in assembler mnemonics, as the author wrote them; it contains no firmware bytes or hex dumps.

The stock guard digests were computed from the author's declared expectations and matched against a local original OS 1.40C MAIN image (SHA-256 164f31224bf61181e3f50e7dec40df9afcae5b16dbf6e4c0d0cc5e986af0a84e).

transforms: The author's V7.3 with six re-encodings, each marked MODWERK, so that no 12 bytes of the USB package repeat stock code (the strict stock-free scan these were made for; the scan no longer refuses a package since base 0.7.5, #1475, and the re-encodings are kept as reviewed): the four inline kernel posts ({0x11, pattern} in dj_unhide and the landing, {0x15, bank} and {0x14, part}) go through one added helper, dj_post, which reaches KPOST through %a1 (the same calls with the same arguments in the same order, every caller inside dj_land, which saves every register); the second purge table's two addresses are loaded in the other order (a3 before a1); and the hand-off's switch time is formed as TICK_A + SCLK instead of SCLK + TICK_A (move.l #imm then add.l: the same sum, register and flags). V7.3's own additions (dj_swres, the restart frame in dj_tprime, dl_commit and dj_cond) are vendored unchanged: they add no stock run (the longest run of the unit also in the stock OS stays 11 counted bytes, none of 16). The unit is 3,918 bytes (the author's 3,938); with these changes taken back it links to the author's bytes (SHA-256 51478a6773f5b987dc98c595f55a3dd88e9de514d1cedb8fbd35cffe4755e48d at 0x400d6d38, his manifest's REFERENCE).

Rewrite the declaration for Modwerk: the same DRAM unit, five detours (the landing, the MIDI START gate, the [PTN] release, V7.2's light Part apply LFO AUTO CHANGE test at 0x40009ebe and V7.3's stock pattern switch COND_RESET call at 0x400a4850) and symbol reference, with every stock expectation an address/length/SHA-256 guard in place of the stock bytes the author's file spells out.

Drop requires=("BATCH_BUGFIXES",): Modwerk modules never depend on another module. The bundle was required for its MIDI_PLAYS_FREE_FIX, which this module has carried since 0.1.1-experimental as a second DRAM unit (patch_trigscale.s) and one more detour, guarded over the 18 stock bytes it redoes.

Drop the two Keeps around the [PTN]-layer YES record (a USB package cannot carry them; the symbol reference's NULL guard still refuses a changed slot) and the conflicts with octabam's DIRECT JUMP and OCTAKIT, which Modwerk does not have.
Add the author fields, UNIT_BYTES and Modwerk's references for the re-encoded units.
